text: I will take from them: Heb. I will cause to perish from them
isles: Or, region by the Sea side
that are in the utmost corners: Heb. cut off into corners, or having the corners of the hair polled, Jeremiah 9.28
which is called by my name: Heb. upon which my Name is called
the days of your slaughter: Heb. your days for slaughter | a pleasant vessel:
And the shepherds shall have no way to flee, nor the principal of the flock to escape: Heb. flight shall perish from the shepherds, and escaping from, etc.
